# done-checkmark-icon.png

**Type:** Small status icon (a blue square with a white checkmark), not a
diagram.
**Source context:** `## Impacts identified` section, used inline three
times next to individual JIRA ticket entries in the API impacts table to
mark that ticket as resolved ("AP-3771 ... backlog → CANCELLED", "AP-3772
... done", "AP-3773 ... done" — the icon marks the "done" outcomes).
Purely decorative status marking; carries no structural information of
its own beyond "this line item is complete."
